Details  The \\\\\"Scheme for Assistance for Start Ups\\\\/ Innovation\\\\\" is an umbrella scheme launched by the Industries and Mines Department, Gujarat under the Gujarat Industrial Policy. Effective from August 7th, 2020 to August 6th, 2025, it aims to drive economic growth by generating jobs, fostering competition, and introducing next-gen solutions.  The component \\\\\"Assistance for Skill Development\\\\\" provides financial support for startups to participate in training programs designed to enhance their soft skills, managerial skills, marketing skills, and financial skills. This initiative aims to enable startups to better understand the ecosystem, raise funds, commercialize their ideas, and scale up their projects.  ##, Benefits  1. **Financial Assistance:** Startups can receive up to \\\\u20b91,00,000\\\\/- for skill development training programs on a reimbursement basis. 2. **Skill Enhancement:** Focused training to improve soft skills, managerial skills, marketing skills, and financing skills.  ##, Eligibility  1. Any individual or group of individuals with an innovative idea or concept, recommended by an approved Nodal Institution, is eligible. 2. The scheme is open to startups in any sector or branch of science, technology, engineering, agriculture, healthcare, etc., making it sector-agnostic.   > ***Note:*** *Startups availing benefits under the Student Startup and Innovation Policy (SSIP) are also eligible.*  ##, Exclusions  1. Hence, the new scheme is being introduced in order to support startups and innovation at different levels of the startup cycle. In view of the strategy under Gujarat Industrial Policy, the Government is pleased to introduce a \\\\\"Scheme for Assistance for Startups \\\\/ Innovation\\\\\" which will come into force from 07\\\\/08\\\\/2020 and will remain in operation for a period of 5 years, i.e. upto 06.08.2025. <\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">The scheme aims to give a further thrust to promoting startups and strengthening the ecosystem in the state, a task force comprised of leading stakeholders in the Gujarat startup ecosystem. Gujarat, owing to its inherent strength of widespread entrepreneurial spirit has gained a significant spot in the national startup ecosystem. The incentives to Startups under the Gujarat Industrial Policy 2015 have supported in the creation of a strong network of nodal institutions and several startups have expanded their operations\\\\/ products both at the national and international levels.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><h4><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Assistance to Startups<\\\\/strong><\\\\/h4><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">The Quantum of Assistance as under would be provided to the Startups whose innovative project is approved\\\\/sanctioned by SLEC.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\"> <\\\\/span><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Sustenance Allowance:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">A sustenance allowance of \\\\u20b9 20,000 per month per startup will be provided to the Startups for a period of one year.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">If startups have at least one woman co-founder, \\\\u20b9 25,000 per month per startup will be provided as a sustenance allowance.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Seed Support:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Seed support up to \\\\u20b9 30,00,000 will be provided to the Startups on the following, based on approval\\\\/ sanction by SLEC:<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">1. Cost of raw materials\\\\/consumables\\\\/hardware &amp; software\\\\/professional services \\\\/other equipment\\\\/ tools required for prototype\\\\/product\\\\/process development<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">2. Market research Testing &amp; Trials<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">3. Marketing\\\\/ publicity assistance: Here marketing\\\\/ publicity assistance covers assistance to startups to attend national\\\\/international events. The fees\\\\/charges paid for attending the same will be considered eligible under this head. <\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">[<\\\\/span><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Note:<\\\\/strong><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\"> However, it is clarified that to and fro conveyance\\\\/accommodation expenses will not be considered for assistance]<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Assistance to Startups having a Significant Impact on Society:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Additional support of upto \\\\u20b9 10,00,000 assistance will be provided to startups having innovative projects which have a significant impact on society, based on the conditions on approval\\\\/ sanction given by the SLEC.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Pre-Series A funding:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">In the life cycle of a Startup, there is a funding gap which is better identified as the valley of death. This is a phase post commercialization where the Startup has just started generating revenue till the time period where its product\\\\/service gets market traction. Such startups will be assisted in getting venture capital. Initially, to support, such mid-level Pre-series A funding to startups, a separate fund shall be created under Gujarat Venture Finance Limited (GVFL). This assistance will be specifically to cater to the startups that have already received seed support from the government under various schemes for the promotion of startups.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Interest subsidy:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">The startups that have been approved\\\\/sanctioned under this scheme will be eligible to avail of an additional interest subsidy of 1%, a maximum of up to 9% on term loans under the provisions of the scheme for assistance to MSMEs.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Assistance to enroll and participate in Acceleration Program:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Assistance up to \\\\u20b9 3,00,000 per startup will be provided to enroll and participate in the national \\\\/ internationally recognized acceleration program. The fees\\\\/charges paid for attending the same will be considered eligible for getting assistance. However, it is clarified that to and fro conveyance\\\\/accommodation expenses will not be considered under this assistance.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Acceleration Program:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">An acceleration program is typically a 3-4 month program for startups at the early traction and scaling stage. Laboratories\\\\/ SDCs (GIDC) \\\\/ Center of Excellence \\\\/ PSUs to support and facilitate innovative ideas\\\\/concepts.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">2. Effective from August 7th, 2020 to August 6th, 2025, it aims to drive economic growth by generating jobs, fostering competition, and introducing next-gen solutions.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">The component \\\\\"Assistance for Skill Development\\\\\" provides financial support for startups to participate in training programs designed to enhance their soft skills, managerial skills, marketing skills, and financial skills.
